title: The Quiet Castle
text: Princess Lily lived in a big castle. The castle was very quiet. Lily had no friends, so Lily was sad. One day {{name}} came to the gate. {{name}} called and asked, "Can I play?" Lily was glad and opened the door. "Yes! Come in!" Lily said with a smile. They ran into the big hall. {{name}} said, "Let us play a game!" They played hide and find. {{name}} hid behind a chair. Lily looked and looked. "I found you!" Lily said. They laughed together. Then they danced in the hall. The room was not quiet now. It was full of fun. {{name}} taught Lily a new song. They sang it loud and clear. The sun went down. {{name}} had to go home. "Will you come back?" Lily asked. "Yes, I will come tomorrow," {{name}} said. Lily gave {{name}} a big hug. Now the castle was not quiet. And Lily was not alone. They were good friends.

summary: 主角拜访住在大城堡里孤单的公主莉莉,陪她玩捉迷藏、跳舞、教她新歌,城堡不再安静,两人成为好朋友。
